channel.title: Money, Mastered
channel.description: Money, Mastered: a 36-chapter audiobook taking you from zero to mastery in macroeconomics, money, investing, trading, and Bitcoin. Hosted by Alex and Jordan.
channel.itunes:author: The Joy Digi
channel.itunes:summary: Money, Mastered: a 36-chapter audiobook taking you from zero to mastery in macroeconomics, money, investing, trading, and Bitcoin. Hosted by Alex and Jordan.

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 1: What Money Really Is
item.description: Chapter 1: what money is, why the dollar has value, and why wealth is not money.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 2: Inflation, the Silent Tax
item.description: Chapter 2: inflation, CPI, winners and losers, and real vs nominal returns.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 3: The Fed and Central Banks
item.description: Chapter 3: central banks, the rate transmission chain, QE, and why you never fight the Fed.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 4: Interest Rates: The Price of Money
item.description: Chapter 4: interest rates as the price of money — how rates are set and why they reprice stocks, housing, and everything else.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 5: Money Supply, QE and QT
item.description: How the Fed expands and contracts the money supply through QE and QT — and why liquidity is the tide that moves every asset.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 6: The Dollar and the Global System
item.description: Chapter 6: how the dollar became the world's reserve currency — and why its moves ripple through every price on the planet.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 7: Stocks: Owning a Slice of a Business
item.description: Chapter 7 explains what a share of stock really is — a slice of a living business — covering equity versus debt, why companies go public, dividends and buybacks, and why stock prices move with interest rates.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 8: Exchanges, Orders, and Market Makers
item.description: You tap buy on your phone, and a fraction of a second later you own a piece of a company — but who sold it to you? Chapter 8 opens the hood of the market: the order book, bids and asks, market versus limit orders, and the market makers who keep every trade moving.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 9: Market Cap and Indexes
item.description: The market was up today — but what does that even mean? This chapter opens up the scoreboard: how market capitalization really works, why a handful of trillion-dollar giants decide where the Dow, the S and P five hundred, and the Nasdaq go, and how an index fund lets you buy the whole basket in a single trade.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 10: Bonds: Lending to Governments and Companies
item.description: There is a market bigger than every stock market on earth combined, and almost nobody talks about it. This chapter opens the bond market: what a bond really is, why prices and yields ride a seesaw, what the ten-year Treasury means for your mortgage, and how credit risk separates a Treasury from junk.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 11: The Yield Curve and What It Tells You
item.description: There is a single line on a chart that has predicted nearly every American recession for fifty years — and this week it is telling a brand-new story. Alex and Jordan unpack the yield curve: why it normally slopes upward, what an inversion really signals, and how to read the bond market's forecast right now.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi

item.title: Money, Mastered — Chapter 12: Commodities: Gold, Silver, Oil
item.description: Gold just crossed four thousand two hundred dollars an ounce, the highest price in human history, while oil sits above one hundred dollars a barrel on Strait of Hormuz risk. Alex and Jordan break down the three forces that move gold, the geopolitical fear premium inside every barrel of oil, and the contango trap that eats investors who buy commodities the easy way.
item.itunes:author: The Joy Digi
